name: Ace of Pentacles
upright: New financial opportunity, prosperity, abundance, physical well-being, seed of wealth.
reversed: Lost opportunity, missed chance, poor investment, waste, lack of resources.

name: Two of Pentacles
upright: Balancing priorities, adaptability, multitasking, juggling finances, flexibility.
reversed: Loss of balance, disorganization, overwhelm, financial strain, poor time management.

name: Three of Pentacles
upright: Teamwork, collaboration, skill-building, craftsmanship, quality work, mentorship.
reversed: Poor teamwork, lack of skills, disorganization, group conflict, low standards.

name: Four of Pentacles
upright: Security, savings, frugality, control, stability, holding onto resources.
reversed: Greed, stinginess, possessiveness, fear of loss, generosity, letting go.

name: Five of Pentacles
upright: Hardship, poverty, isolation, feeling left out, financial struggle, loss.
reversed: Recovery, charity, improvement, acceptance, overcoming hardship, hope.

name: Six of Pentacles
upright: Generosity, charity, sharing, repayment, giving and receiving, balance.
reversed: Strings attached, debt, dependency, one-sidedness, greed, conditional giving.

name: Seven of Pentacles
upright: Patience, long-term view, investing, waiting for results, diligence, assessment.
reversed: Impatience, wasted effort, lack of rewards, distractions, poor investment.

name: Eight of Pentacles
upright: Work ethic, mastery, apprenticeship, dedication, improving skills, routine.
reversed: Perfectionism, uninspired, lack of motivation, cutting corners, poor quality.

name: Nine of Pentacles
upright: Luxury, independence, abundance, self-sufficiency, enjoying fruits of labor.
reversed: Over-reliance on money, recklessness, living beyond means, false success.

name: Ten of Pentacles
upright: Legacy, inheritance, long-term security, family wealth, culmination, dynasty.
reversed: Financial ruin, family disputes, lack of legacy, fleeting success, instability.

name: Page of Pentacles
upright: Ambition, study, diligence, new business venture, student, practical learner.
reversed: Laziness, lack of commitment, procrastination, unrealized potential, distraction.

name: Knight of Pentacles
upright: Routine, reliability, hard work, steady progress, methodical, dependable.
reversed: Boredom, stagnation, inflexibility, obsession with details, slacking off.

name: Queen of Pentacles
upright: Nurturing, practicality, financial security, earthy, supportive, homemaker.
reversed: Smothering, jealousy, self-centeredness, neglecting needs, workaholic.

name: King of Pentacles
upright: Business leader, provider, wealth, stability, successful entrepreneur, patron.
reversed: Greed, exploitation, stubbornness, miserliness, abuse of power, rigidity.
